verdict.rationale: Figma's first-party pages say its built-in agent can generate new design directions from prompts, refine them iteratively, and build from a PRD with existing design context ([figma-docs-17], [figma-docs-34], [figma-docs-51], [figma-docs-43]). The MCP server also lets agents write and modify native Figma content on the canvas ([figma-docs-38], [figma-docs-52], [figma-docs-59]), and FigJam diagrams can be generated from prompts ([figma-docs-42]), though one community comment calls FigJam's AI tools often broken ([figma-comm-8]). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the prompt-to-mockup workflow and its output fidelity, and independent hands-on corroboration that full layouts or mockups are produced well.
